title: Java4Shell, NGINX2Shell and more: Why we are not at "Yellow", (Wed, Nov 18th)
description: Recent critical vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Java and NGINX, alongside a major Microsoft 365 outage and the earlier php2shell vulnerability. Despite numerous attacks observed on Java-specific honeypots, no exploitation of the Java4Shell vulnerability has been detected yet. The Internet Storm Center maintains an Infocon status of Green, indicating that while the threat environment is active, it remains within normal operational expectations. Organizations are advised to patch these vulnerabilities and adopt sustainable security practices including automation and reducing exposure rather than treating these events as emergencies.
